llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM工艺参数对钛中氧氮含量的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学性能，与用户方向关联微弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not investigate porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or surface roughness/osseointegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光功率对SLM纯钛中氧和氮含量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率制备CP-Ti样品，分析氧氮浓度。
summary_zh.result: 激光功率增加导致氧氮含量升高，影响材料纯度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过化学成分分析验证浓度变化。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser power on the interstitial element uptake (oxygen and nitrogen) in commercially pure titanium processed by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: CP-Ti samples were fabricated at varying laser powers, and oxygen and nitrogen concentrations were measured using inert gas fusion analysis.
summary_en.result: Increased laser power led to higher oxygen and nitrogen contents, affecting the chemical purity of the as-built material.
summary_en.validation: Chemical composition analysis was used to validate the concentration changes with laser power.

papers.title: Projections of primary hip arthroplasty in Germany until 2040
papers.abstract: Background and purpose — The number of hip replacements in Germany has increased considerably during the last 2 decades but lately levelled off with no significant increase in operation rates. We analyzed the future trend of hip arthroplasty and projected the number of primary hip replacements that will be performed in Germany until 2040. Patients and methods — We used prevalence data of hip arthroplasty patients from 2010 to 2016 from the nationwide inpatient statistics and population forecasts from the German Federal Bureau of Statistics up to the year 2040. We used Poisson regression to estimate the expected annual number of arthroplasty surgeries with calendar year and patient age as covariates to account for differences among age groups and changes over time. Results — The number of primary hip replacements performed in Germany in 2040 was estimated to grow by 27% to 288 x 103 (95% CI 250 x 103–332 x 103) from 2010. Projected counts were highest for patients aged 60 to 70 years. The estimated incidence rate was projected to 360 (95% CI 312–414) per 100,000 residents. However, incidence rates for individual age classes were found to be constant with a slight decrease over time for individual age classes. Interpretation — Our findings suggest a growth in the total hip arthroplasty count whereas incidence rate remained constant over age classes. We consider the future demographic change to an older population as well as the increasing life expectancy to be the main reasons for the increasing patient numbers rather than a general increase in the operation frequency.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注未来髋关节置换手术数量的流行病学预测，未涉及任何植入物力学或生物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not contain any biomechanical modeling, implant design, stress shielding, micromotion, or FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测德国到2040年的初次髋关节置换手术数量。
summary_zh.method: 基于2010-2016年住院统计数据和人口预测，使用泊松回归建模。
summary_zh.result: 预计2040年手术量增长27%，主要原因是人口老龄化和寿命延长。
summary_zh.validation: 使用历史数据拟合回归模型，未进行外部验证。

summary_en.motivation: To project the future number of primary hip arthroplasties in Germany up to 2040 considering demographic changes.
summary_en.method: Poisson regression was applied to nationwide inpatient data (2010-2016) and population forecasts, with calendar year and age as covariates.
summary_en.result: The total number of primary hip replacements in 2040 is estimated to increase by 27% to 288,000, driven by an aging population.
summary_en.validation: Model fit was assessed on historical incidence rates; no independent validation dataset was used.

papers.title: Effect of Heat Treatment on Mechanical Properties of Ni-base Superalloy Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting
papers.venue: Japan Society of Powder and Powder Metallurgy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于镍基高温合金的热处理，不涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structures, no stress shielding, no osseointegration, no fatigue testing for implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对选区激光熔化镍基高温合金力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备试样，并进行不同热处理工艺。
summary_zh.result: 报道了热处理后合金的拉伸强度和硬度变化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准力学测试验证性能变化。

summary_en.motivation: Study the effect of heat treatment on mechanical properties of Ni-base superalloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by selective laser melting and subjected to various heat treatment cycles.
summary_en.result: Changes in tensile strength and hardness after heat treatment were reported.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing was used to validate property changes.
